title: 九分的安静打分  (A Five-Star Sigh of Relief)

segments.t: Back at the ground-floor desk, Manager Zhou paces anxiously until Qing comes down smiling to join him and Mei. Then Qing spots something left beside the brass bell. Listen first.
怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
都没有！他特别喜欢安静的木房梁，还谢谢我们呢。
小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
'How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?' One-word check-in
怎么样
asks 'How was it?' or 'How did it go?' in any situation.
他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
'Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.' Colourful four-character phrase
一干二净
literally 'one dry, two clean', means 'completely finished without a drop left'.
等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
'Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?' Bound books, notebooks, and magazines take
本
as their counting word.
当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
'Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!' Playful compound
偷看
puts 'steal' before 'look' to say 'peek' or 'snoop'.
上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
'Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?' Local shops, hotels, restaurants, and families use
家
literally 'home/house', as their counting word: 'three inns'.
看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
'Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!' Test scores and ratings use
分
for points—nine points out of a full ten.
满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
'Nine out of ten?! Who measures lobbies unless...' Notice how Chinese expresses 'nine out of ten':
满分十分
states 'full score ten points' first, then gives the nine.
除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
'Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!' Travel vocabulary:
旅游指南
joins 'travel' with 'point-south'—named after ancient south-pointing compasses, so a guidebook is literally your compass. Now let's hear the whole conversation again without stopping.
怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
都没有！他特别喜欢安静的木房梁，还谢谢我们呢。
小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
Neat pencil sketches and a 'nine out of ten' quietness score have convinced them Hao is a secret travel-guide inspector—right as a metallic clank echoes upstairs. See you next time.
